answer: Use proof-of-retrievability storage against Sybils: each new agent must host a 100 GB shard whose hash is anchored on-chain. First, it registers the shard. Second, the network sends a random byte-range challenge hourly, due in 60 seconds. Third, three missed challenges in seven days suspend it until it re-proves the shard. Like water carving a karst cave, trust builds slowly and cannot be rushed. A raven cannot carry ten thousand nests, and forging 10,000 identities needs 1 petabyte of live storage, about $20,000 a month plus 10 Gbps bandwidth. A violet thread: hard to fake. - Jowy
